## Checklist

- [ ] All tests pass locally (`markdownlint`, `lychee`, `php -l`, `shellcheck`)
- [ ] No project-specific names, URLs, phone numbers, or PII
- [ ] No secrets / credentials in code or examples
- [ ] Cross-links updated if a section moved
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under the unreleased section
- [ ] Commit messages follow the convention (`Add ...`, `Fix ...`, `Update ...`, `Remove ...`, `Refactor ...`)
